title: Should You Take a Boat Trip From Funchal or From Calheta?
description: Funchal boats run west past Câmara de Lobos, Cabo Girão and Fajã dos Padres. Calheta boats show the quieter southwest. Start near where you are staying.
heroAlt: Drone view of Calheta marina and its golden sand beach behind breakwaters on Madeira's southwest coast
keywords: should you take a boat trip from funchal or calheta
where to take a boat trip in madeira

People tiny on the sand. Natural light, true colours, no text.
